source.title: Call for Applicants - WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) Members (November 2022)
source.content:
The new WCA Sports Organization Team (WSOT) is seeking members!

The WSOT is a newly created team with the goal of seeking further recognition of the WCA as a sporting organization both nationally and globally. The WSOT will be working closely with regional organizations on national recognition and the WCA Board/relevant teams and committees on global recognition. The WSOT is a great chance to be a part of change in how the organization operates!

<!-- break -->

The official rights and duties of the WSOT are documented in WCA Motion [10.2022.13](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.13%20-%20Sports%20Organization%20Team.pdf).

The expected qualities of applicants include:

* Proactive personality, sense of detail, and solution-oriented thinking.
* Eye for detail in reviewing and writing lengthy complicated documents
* A passion for speedcubing with a desire to see it's success on the world sporting stage
* Sufficient familiarity with the WCA Policies, Bylaws and Regulations.
* (Desirable) Involvement in high level sports as a participant or official

Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

* A brief personal introduction.
* A summary of activities done for the WCA
* A concrete overview on how you fulfil the requirements, and the expected qualities.
* (Optional) Qualities and qualifications you find relevant that are not listed above.

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application document from now until **December 20th 2022 23:59 UTC** to Ethan Pride (epride@worldcubeassociation.org). Any applicants with questions are encouraged to reach out before the end of the application deadline!

translation.title: WCA 体育组织团队招募成员（2022 年 11 月）
translation.content:
新成立的 WCA 体育组织团队（WSOT）正在招募成员！

WSOT 的目标是推动 WCA 在各国及全球范围内获得更多作为体育组织的认可。在国家层面，团队将与地区组织紧密合作；在全球层面，则与 WCA 董事会及相关团队、委员会共同推进。加入 WSOT，你将有机会参与 WCA 运作方式的改变！

<!-- break -->

WSOT 的正式权利与职责见 WCA [10.2022.13 号议案](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.13%20-%20Sports%20Organization%20Team.pdf)。

我们希望申请人具备：

* 积极主动、注重细节，善于解决问题。
* 能细致审阅和撰写篇幅较长、内容复杂的文档。
* 热爱速拧，希望看到它在世界体育舞台上取得成绩。
* 较熟悉 WCA 的政策、章程和竞赛规则。
* （加分项）以运动员或工作人员身份参与高水平体育赛事的经历。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，包含：

* 简短的个人介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
* 具体说明自己如何满足申请条件及上述要求。
* （选填）其他你认为与岗位有关的素质和资历。

申请从即日起开放，请于 **2022 年 12 月 20 日 23:59 UTC** 前将材料发送给 Ethan Pride（epride@worldcubeassociation.org）。如有疑问，欢迎在申请截止前联系！
